correctness.rationale: Every selected clique fiber must have m-1 or m vertices. For mixed empty and partial fibers, zero-run length<=2, separating runs have >=2 full fibers and any run containing a partial fiber has >=4; therefore f>=z+2. Coupled with the exact counting identity and gamma_t(C_n)<=n/2+1 this gives the lower bound. The zero-free and partial-free cases complete the proof. Published cycle total-domination formula and explicit cyclic constructions prove the upper bound. Three independent finite verification modes run and pass (8 labelled full-subset, 240 exact transfer and 4424 explicit instances). Finite data corroborates rather than replaces infinite proof.

value.rationale: A recent 2026 program explicitly studies restricted domination in Cartesian products. The theorem closes the generally nontrivial gap between nm/2 and m gamma_1(C_n) for three distinct cycle residue classes, for every clique size m>=3, and shows a sharp width-2 exception. Its structural rigidity argument for mixed empty, partial and full clique fibers reveals why the general upper bound is exact and produces a four-periodic law on a natural two-parameter graph family. It is not a single small increment or a parameter substitution.
